Thanks for the response.
We analyzed the logs and found that the issue was reported 4 times in the last week. We also checked the router settings and noticed that the interface had been changed. Despite multiple remote reset attempts, we were unsuccessful.
The charger is currently running an older
v3.2.8-0-g4104b8b
, and we may get significant improvements by updating it to the latest firmware. Once the upgrade is completed, we will reassess to determine if the issue persists.
So, could you please ask the customer if it can be update with the latest firmware version and if yes then let us know the date and time so that we can proceed further to upgrade it.
Regards,
